reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "no magnesium oxide" and the 100 mg elemental per capsule, plus the QR to a named ISO 17025 lab report, which is exactly what I check before buying. I would try one box of the bisglycinate; the sachet in my bag might help me stop forgetting them on the counter.
objection: Two capsules a day, and size 00 capsules are big. I also forget vitamins half the time, so I may not finish the box, and I have not verified that the lab report is real until I scan it.
would_change_my_mind: If the batch report behind the QR looked fake or did not show the magnesium content matching the label, I would not buy. A smaller capsule or one capsule per serving would make it an easy yes.
